title: Steamed Rice with Spiced Fried Chicken, Curry Gravy and Sambal Belacan
title_ms: Nasi Kukus Ayam Berempah dengan Kuah Gulai dan Sambal Belacan
description: A complete nasi kukus set: fragrant spiced fried chicken, steamed basmati rice, a rich curry-style gravy with eggplant and long beans, and a spicy-sour sambal belacan.
description_ms: Set nasi kukus lengkap: ayam goreng berempah yang wangi, nasi basmati kukus, kuah gulai yang kaya rasa dengan terung dan kacang panjang, serta sambal belacan pedas-masam.
ingredients: whole spices (cinnamon, cloves, star anise, cardamom)
steps: [Ayam Berempah] Blend 4 lemongrass stalks and a knob of galangal; strain and keep only the pulp (discard liquid). Mix pulp with 1 tsp each: curry powder, chilli powder, coriander powder, fennel seeds, cumin, turmeric powder; 0.5 tsp salt; 2 stalks curry leaf; a little water. Marinate chicken for 20 minutes.
Fry the marinated chicken (the pulp goes in too for crunch) until golden and crispy.
[Nasi Kukus] Rinse basmati rice; add water and steam for 20–25 minutes until fluffy.
[Kuah Gulai] Blend 1 sweet onion, a knob of ginger and 5 garlic cloves. Sauté with whole spices.
Add 3 tbsp blended chilli (mild), 3 tbsp beef curry spice mix and 2 tbsp korma spice mix; cook until oil separates.
Add chicken innards or offcuts if available; add water and 1 small box coconut milk.
Season with half a small palm sugar block, salt and seasoning powder.
Add eggplant and long beans; cook until tender.

[Sambal Belacan] Blend 2 bell peppers, 10 bird's eye chillies and a small amount of roasted shrimp paste. Squeeze in juice of 4 calamansi limes (remove seeds). Blend 2 more calamansi limes whole (seeds removed). Add 2 tbsp sugar, a little seasoning powder, salt and a little water. Blend until smooth.
Plate rice with chicken, ladle gravy over and top with sambal belacan.
steps_ms: [Ayam Berempah] Blend 4 batang serai dan seketul lengkuas; tapis, ambil serdak sahaja (buang air). Gaul serdak dengan 1 sudu kecil setiap satu: serbuk kari, serbuk cili, serbuk ketumbar, jintan manis, jintan putih, serbuk kunyit; setengah sudu kecil garam; 2 tangkai daun kari; sedikit air. Perap ayam 20 minit.
Goreng ayam berempah (serdak ikut sekali untuk bunyi krup) sehingga golden crispy.
[Nasi Kukus] Basuh beras basmati; masukkan air dan kukus 20-25 minit sehingga gebu.
[Kuah Gulai] Blend 1 bawang Holland, seketul halia dan 5 ulas bawang putih. Tumis dengan rempah 4 sekawan.
Masukkan 3 sudu cili kisar (tak pedas), 3 sudu rempah kari daging dan 2 sudu rempah kurma daging; masak sehingga pecah minyak.
Masukkan hati/dalaman ayam jika ada; tambah air dan 1 kotak kecil santan.
Tambah separuh ketul kecil gula Melaka, garam dan serbuk perasa.
Masukkan terung dan kacang panjang; masak sehingga lembut.

[Sambal Belacan] Blend 2 lada besar, 10 cili padi dan sedikit belacan yang dah dibakar. Perah jus 4 biji limau kasturi (buang biji). Blend 2 biji limau kasturi lagi (buang biji) bersama kulit. Tambah 2 sudu gula, sedikit serbuk perasa, garam dan sedikit air. Blend sehingga lumat.
Susun nasi bersama ayam, tuang kuah gulai dan letak sambal belacan di atas.
